title: US-Iran Ceasefire Declared — Strikes Continue
narrative: A US-Iran ceasefire was announced approximately two weeks prior to May 28, 2026. On May 28, BBC timestamped reports at 05:32 GMT documented oil prices jumping after the US launched new attacks on Iran — strikes on missile sites and boats, described as "self-defence." Iran said it targeted an American base after the US strikes and reported downing a US drone that "entered Iranian airspace." The strikes occurred while Iranian and Qatari negotiators were in Doha for peace talks. Iranian internet shutdown ended only days prior, suggesting the regime was resuming normal communications under what it believed was an active truce.
telemetry: BBC May 28, 05:32 GMT: 'Oil prices jump after US launches new attacks on Iran' — strikes on missile sites and boats characterized as 'self-defence'
Iran says it targeted American base AFTER US strikes — May 28, 11:52 GMT
Iran reports downing US drone that 'entered Iranian airspace' — US has not denied this
Strikes occurred WHILE Iranian and Qatari negotiators were in Doha for peace talks (BBC, May 26)
Ceasefire announced approximately 2 weeks prior; Iranian internet shutdown ended only days ago
US strike timestamps and Iranian response directly contradict diplomatic narrative of active ceasefire
analysis:
If a ceasefire is real, US strikes should have stopped. If a ceasefire is real, Iran wouldn't be targeting US bases. The physical evidence — US strike timestamps, Iranian response, drone downing — directly contradicts the diplomatic narrative. BBC timestamped reports document oil prices surging on new US attacks on Iran, while Iranian and Qatari negotiators were simultaneously in Doha for peace talks. Both things cannot be true.

The question is not whether the ceasefire was violated — it was. The question is whether it ever existed as anything other than a public relations framework. The US characterizes strikes on missile sites as "self-defence" while Iran responds kinetically, and both sides maintain the pretense of a diplomatic process. The public is being told the war is paused while every data point shows kinetic action ongoing. The ceasefire is a diplomatic fiction — and the bombs falling on May 28 are the proof.
verdict: [SIPHONED VERDICT]: The US bombed Iran while negotiators sat in Doha for peace talks — the ceasefire was a diplomatic fiction maintained by both sides while bombs continued to fall.
